339-677-6965-8249.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4687-4702-5115.notablePrerequisites: Gemstone Array has at least four counters on it.
4687-4702-5115.description:
Activate Splinter Twin by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Gemstone Array.
Activate Gemstone Array as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Gemstone Array, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

792-2738-4871-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Totentanz, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2921-7084-7889.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

348-1152-3191-6887-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-3191-6887-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Kairi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Kairi and any creature not part of the combo.
When Kairi dies, it and The Skullspore Nexus triggers.
Resolve the Kairi trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

3875-5702-6973-7824.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
3875-5702-6973-7824.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the first Mutable Explorer trigger, creating two Mutavault land tokens that enters tapped.
When the Mutavault tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko and Tireless Provisioner each trigger twice.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Holding priority, activate the Treasures by tapping them, adding {1}{G}
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

372-1090-2955.manaNeeded: {5}{W}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
372-1090-2955.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Restoration Angel until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Justiciar's Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Restoration Angel to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Restoration Angel's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Restoration Angel until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Restoration Angel trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

3821-4518-5921.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{W}{U}.
3821-4518-5921.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

5702-6441--143.manaNeeded: {2}{G} plus enough mana to animate the land
5702-6441--143.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a land that doesn't have summoning sickness and that can tap to produce at least {G}.
5702-6441--143.description:
Earthbend a land that can tap to produce at least {G}, thus animating it.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated land.
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the land it is attached to due to Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
When the land tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the two land tokens by tapping them, adding at least {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and create two 1/1 Insect creature tokens due to Elspeth, Storm Slayer
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the land it is attached to due to Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Repeat from step 5.

232-3129-5778-6867.description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying its mana cost plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, its innate ability and its offspring ability trigger.
Resolve the innate Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}
Resolve the offspring trigger, creating two token copies of Priest of Urabrask that are 1/1.
When the Priest of Urabrask tokens enter, they each trigger, adding six {R}.
Cast Appa by paying its mana cost plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Appa enters, its innate ability and its offspring ability trigger.
Resolve the innate Appa trigger, airbending the nontoken Priest of Urabrask.
Resolve the offspring trigger, creating two token copies of Appa that are 1/1.
Put both Appa tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Both Appa tokens' enter-the-battlefield ability trigger, airbending Appa with one trigger and nothing with the other.
Cast Priest of Urabrask from exile by paying {2} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
Repeat steps 2 through 5 once.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {2} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
Repeat from step 7.
232-3129-5778-6867.notes: Once you have extra mana, other nonland permanents can be airbended using Appa and returned to the battlefield each loop as desired.

2034-3490-6823-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3490-6823-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

3713-3755-5078-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
3713-3755-5078-6650.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

1510-3698-4574-5849.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Arcbound Stinger.
When Arcbound Stinger dies, its modular ability triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Arcbound Stinger from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Arcbound Stinger from the top of your library by paying {0} due to Fortune Teller's Talent.
When Arcbound Stinger enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

950-5223-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Fatestitcher.
Activate one of the Fatestitcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Fatestitcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

343-2366-5702-6965.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
343-2366-5702-6965.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Regal Behemoth triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-2734-3334-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Cyberdrive Awakener
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

2060-2700-2744-4029-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Arcbound Shikari.
When Arcbound Shikari enters the battlefield, it and Cathars' Crusade trigger.
Resolve the Arcbound Shikari trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other artifact creature you control.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

284-2921-6972--112.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Angel of Invention.
When Angel of Invention dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Angel of Invention enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.
284-2921-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Angel of Invention's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

3564-4050-4275-5329.easyPrerequisites: You control another untapped nontoken Merfolk.
3564-4050-4275-5329.description:
Activate Kumena's first ability by tapping another nontoken Merfolk you control.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kumena ability.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk token.
When the Merfolk dies, Faces of the Past triggers, untapping all Merfolk.
Repeat.
3564-4050-4275-5329.notes: You can tap as many nontoken Merfolk as able each iteration by repeating steps 1 through 3 for each Merfolk. They will all be untapped by Faces of the Past.

3532-3594-3836-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Toothy triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2438-5220-5933-6900.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

918-4083-4090.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal damage to Donna Noble.
Donna Noble is indestructible.
918-4083-4090.description:
Deal damage to Donna Noble.
Donna Noble and Repercussion trigger.
Resolve the Donna Noble trigger, dealing damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Repercussion trigger, dealing damage to Donna Noble instead of you due to Pariah.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-4929-6842.description:
Activate Iron Spider by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on each artifact creature and/or Vehicle you control.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Iron Spider.
Repeat.
1978-4929-6842.notes: This combo doesn't put infinite counters on Cryptic Trilobite.

1921-2846-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control at least X Vampires.
1921-2846-4659.description:
Activate Tawnos's second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it and sacrificing two artifact tokens, exiling Dominating Vampire from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When the Dominating Vampire token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Tawnos's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Dominating Vampire token and causing you to mill two cards.
When the Dominating Vampire token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Dominating Vampire token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

851-4321-5777-6451.description:
Activate Camellia by paying {2} and sacrificing a Food.
Camellia's first ability triggers, creating two Foods and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Resolve the Camellia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Squirrel you control.
Activate the two Foods by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

1116-3240-5670-6752.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1116-3240-5670-6752.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
When the Graveborn enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Nether Traitor enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

3951-4365-4875-5703.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
3951-4365-4875-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

413-862-5220-5683.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Crimson Kobolds.
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Crimson Kobolds and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crimson Kobolds enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

224-872-1525-3848.notablePrerequisites:
Scaled Herbalist does not have summoning sickness.
You have a land card in hand.
You control at least seven lands.
224-872-1525-3848.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm and Omnath's second ability triggers.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on an Elemental you control, and then causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand due to Abundance.
Repeat.

1365-3263-3967-4853--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-3263-3967-4853--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2350-2908-3682-5542.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana.
Cast Dream Stalker by paying one mana.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers twice due to Delney, returning Mox Amber and Dream Stalker from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3341-4298-4613.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
Charnelhoard Wurm has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
3341-4298-4613.description:
Activate Charnelhoard Wurm using Borborygmos Enraged's ability by discarding a land card, dealing 3 damage to an opponent.
Charnelhoard Wurm triggers, returning a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2882-3079-3381-4999.notablePrerequisites:
Infinite Reflection attached to Morgue Toad.
You have discarded at least two cards this turn.
2882-3079-3381-4999.description:
Cast Hollow One either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying at most {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Morgue Toad due to Infinite Reflection.
Activate Hollow One by sacrificing it, adding {U}{R}.
If you cast Hollow One from your graveyard, Hollow One is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Hollow One's cycling ability.
Repeat.

1077-1972-4691.description:
Cast Wrong Turn by paying {2}{U}, giving control of Vilis to an opponent.
During that opponent's draw step, they draw a card.
Nekusar triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Vilis triggers, causing the opponent to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3 until the opponent loses the game either due to drawing from an empty library, or from having 0 life.

1042-1331-2557-5157.notablePrerequisites:
Scythe of the Wretched attached to Tempting Witch.
You control at least two Foods.
1042-1331-2557-5157.description:
Activate Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar by sacrificing two Foods, causing Tempting Witch to deal six damage to itself.
Tempting Witch dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Scythe of the Wretched triggers, returning Tempting Witch from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Scythe of the Wretched to it.
When Tempting Witch enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two Food tokens.
Repeat.

624-2719-3191-3890-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Phantasmal Image, adding {B}.
When Phantasmal Image dies, it triggers, causing you to mill six cards and return Unearth and up to one other instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Unearth by paying {B}, returning Phantasmal Image from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Kairi.
Repeat.
